design_concept.direction: Dark Editorial Industrial. Blending high-end machinery precision with organic earthly environments. The aesthetic is 'technical credibility meets natural power'—like a luxury car brand, but for cutting-edge agricultural machinery. It pushes a dark-mode foundation utilizing 'Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy' tones.
core_principles: Emotion First: The tension between cold metallic precision and warm earthy nature.
Contrast: Deep shadows vs. spotlight product photography.
Asymmetry: Bento grid structures and offset text to create an editorial flow.
Motion: Premium momentum scrolling (Lenis) and kinetic text reveals (Framer Motion).

scale_rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

typography.notes: No Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for industrial heft. Use Cormorant Garamond strictly for the numbered manifesto chapters for that editorial contrast.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Tetris Grid (Mode A) for marketing sections. High Density Grid (Mode B) for the Admin Dashboard.

surfaces.cards: bg-surface border border-border p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-500

motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: Masked line-by-line text reveal. Use `overflow: hidden` on lines, and animate `y: '100%'` to `y: '0%'` with `ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1]`.
motion.parallax: Subtle framer-motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` on hero background images.
motion.marquee: React Fast Marquee: Slow, elegant editorial ribbon. Low contrast (dark green bg, earthy text), wide gaps (gap-32), font-serif.
motion.scroll_reveals: Staggered fade-up (`y: 40`, `opacity: 0`) for sections as they enter viewport.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons have a subtle scale-down on click, arrow icons translate-x-1 on hover.

home.hero: Massive kinetic typography ('Potência e Precisão'). Background: Subtly parallaxing drone view of dark farm fields. Image overlay: bg-black/60. Line-by-line reveal on load.
home.services_preview: Bento grid of services. Hover states reveal spotlight images of machinery diagnostics.
home.marquee: Slow scrolling text: 'TECNOLOGIA DE PONTA EM MANUTENÇÃO AGRÍCOLA • LG INDUSTRIAL • '
home.products_teaser: Horizontal scroll or asymmetrical bento featuring top-tier agricultural machinery with 'Solicitar Orçamento' buttons.
home.footer: Massive 'LG Industrial' text at the bottom. Clean, grid-based links.

produtos.card_style: Clipped frames with spotlight photography. High contrast.
produtos.actions: Every product card MUST have a prominent 'Solicitar Orçamento' button linking to WhatsApp or contact form with product ID passed as context.

servicos.layout: Alternating asymmetrical blocks. Heavy reliance on negative space.
servicos.content: Diagnostics, Maintenance, Field Service. Use high-quality mechanic photography.

sobre.features: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) using massive Cormorant Garamond serif numerals. Deep storytelling about commitment to the agricultural sector.

politica.layout: Narrow reading column (max-w-3xl). Grid borders for a technical, legally binding look. Swiss Brutalist typography approach.

contato.layout: Split screen. Left: Huge typography and direct contact info (WhatsApp link). Right: Shadcn Form customized with dark-mode inputs (border-b only, no full boxes).
contato.functionality: Form submission sends email + logs to Admin.

admin.components: Shadcn tables, data-cards. Purely functional, no parallax. Colors: Background #0A0D0B, cards #111612.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-text_main px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-accent_earth text-accent_earth px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold hover:bg-accent_earth hover:text-background transition-colors

components.forms: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Inputs should have transparent backgrounds with `border-b border-border`, focus state `border-primary`.
components.navigation: Crystal Glass header (`bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl`). Logo left, links center, WhatsApp CTA right.

hero_backgrounds.description: Tractor plowing field at sunset - use for home hero parallax
Aerial patterns of farmland - alternative hero/footer background

products_machinery.description: Green metal wheel close up - use for texture/product detail

services.description: Professionals repairing machinery - use for maintenance service
Mechanic diagnosing engine - use for diagnostics service
Shiny metal gears - use for precision machinery context

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has dark overlays (bg-black/60) to maintain APCA readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='solicitar-orcamento-btn'`).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for Lenis and Framer transitions.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output generic 'AI slop' layouts. Follow the bento grid and asymmetrical rules.
Always use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
Apply `data-testid` to all forms, buttons, and major links.
DO NOT center text globally. Align left for readability, center only for specific editorial moments.
Use generous spacing (`py-24` or `py-32`). Avoid cramped containers.
Ensure dark mode is strictly enforced, no bright white backgrounds.
NEVER use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
DO NOT use a completely transparent header. Use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent dark background.
